user.title: Add a route
user.description: One route at a time; add the integration again for a second route. Start and destination can be an address, a coordinate (52.09, 5.12) or an entity such as zone.home or person.name. Get a free TomTom key at developer.tomtom.com.

data_description.name: Becomes the device name and the start of the entity IDs, such as sensor.to_work_travel_time.
data_description.api_key: One key covers all your routes; it is filled in for a second route.
data_description.start: zone.home is the address set in Home Assistant. With person.name you leave from wherever that person is now.
data_description.via: At most three, one per line. With a stop, the departure time is worked back from arriving at the final destination.
data_description.destination: As complete an address as possible, including the town.

bevestig.title: Are these addresses right?
bevestig.description:
TomTom found:

{punten}

Travel time now: {reistijd} min.

If an address is wrong, cancel and start again with a more precise one (street, number and town). When the route is shown and when you want to arrive is set afterwards under Configure.

error.adres_niet_gevonden: TomTom cannot find this address. Add the town, or use a coordinate.
error.geen_locatie: This entity has no location right now.
error.sleutel_geweigerd: TomTom refuses the key: invalid, not enabled for the Routing and Search APIs, or the daily quota is used up.
error.geen_route: TomTom finds no road route between these points.
error.tomtom_fout: TomTom gave no usable answer. Try again in a few minutes.

init.title: Route
init.description: If the key or an address changes, they are looked up at TomTom again. The schedule per weekday is on the next page.

data_description.start: An address, a coordinate, or an entity such as zone.home or person.name.
data_description.via: At most three, one per line.
data_description.destination: As complete an address as possible, including the town.
data_description.margin_minutes: How many minutes before the arrival time you want to be there: parking, walking in. Always shown on the card.
data_description.stop_minutes: How long you stand still at each stop. TomTom does not count it; the departure moves that much earlier.
data_description.travel_mode: What TomTom calculates the route for.
data_description.avoid: A preference, not a ban: TomTom uses them if there is no other way.
data_description.alternatives: How many other routes the detail view lists, with how much longer they take.
data_description.scan_minutes: Only inside the window; nothing is requested outside it. Two requests each time when there is an arrival time.

rooster.title: Schedule per weekday
rooster.description: For each day: from and until when the route is shown (and requested from TomTom), and what time you want to arrive. A day without times is a day without the route. Without an arrival time the card shows the travel time and when you would arrive if you left now.

error.venster_half: {dag}: fill in both 'show from' and 'show until', or neither.
error.venster_omgekeerd: {dag}: 'show until' is before 'show from'. A window across midnight is not possible; make it two days.
error.aankomst_zonder_venster: {dag}: an arrival time without a window is never requested. Also fill in from and until when the route is shown.
